name: Captain
description: A seasoned warrior commanding respect and loyalty through a combination of charisma, strategic genius, and sheer ruthlessness.

name: Champion
description: These fighters are the heart and soul of the warband, inspiring their comrades both through martial prowess and friendly banter.

name: Marksman
description: Driven away from home by the civil war, these forest-born huntsmen now stalk targets with the patience they once reserved for prey.

name: Warrior
description: Disgraced state troopers, murderers and treasure hunters make up the backbone of the warband, driven forwards by the promise of coin.

name: Youngblood
description: With the civil war bleeding the Empire dry of seasoned fighters, the young must pick up arms to fight for their province.
